Hi Samir / Ayesha,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and a concrete next-steps plan so we can get your trial running by the end of next week.

High-level success criteria (attached as spreadsheet: greenline_poc_success_criteria.xlsx):
- Inference latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms for 512-token requests
- Throughput: sustained 100 requests/min with 99.9% success rate
- Cost target: <= $0.015 per 1k tokens under test workload
- Quality: F1 >= 0.82 on your intent/extraction eval set (sheet: GL-Eval-Set)

Proposed evaluation plan & owners:
- Week 0 (this week): access & environment setup — Olga (AE) / Marissa (Onboarding)
- Week 1: baseline run + small-scale ingest — Rishi (SE) / Greenline infra (Ayesha)
- Week 2: drive scale tests + qualitative checks — joint

Credentials / provisioning asks (what we need from you or will provision):
- SSO invites for primary test users (Ayesha + 1 infra) — please confirm emails to invite
- API key(s) for staging environment (30-day trial keys) — we will issue; please provide IP ranges to allowlist
- Optionally, a service account token for automated ingestion (we can issue scoped key)

Please confirm: 1) the main evaluation contact (is Ayesha the right owner?), 2) the IP CIDR(s) we should allowlist, and 3) any procurement/PO timing (if your procurement team requires an MSA or PO before keys).

Attachments: greenline_poc_success_criteria.xlsx, ip_allowlist_template.txt (simple template of CIDR entries).

Goal: get credentials and SSO invites out by EOD Tuesday (Aug 18) so Rishi can kick off the baseline run Wed/Thu.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m if you want to walk the plan.

Best,
Olga

Thanks Olga — solid recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Ownership: yes — Ayesha is the primary owner for infra coordination; I am the product lead and will run the evaluation with her.
2) IP ranges: our infra team will provide a short list (likely 3 CIDRs). I'll loop Ayesha to confirm specifics.
3) API keys: we prefer a service-account style key for automated ingestion. Can the trial key be scoped to staging only and have short TTL? That would be ideal.
4) Procurement: our procurement team prefers a 30-day SOW/PO for trials larger than $25k expected consumption. At this stage it'll be internal approval; I will let you know if they need an MSA signature.

Also: can Redwood limit telemetry collection for our test runs? We prefer minimal logs during the trial — is there an option for reduced telemetry or a privacy-first setting?

If you can send the SSO invites to aya+infra@greenline.ai and the temporary API key to samir+dev@greenline.ai that'd speed things up.

Samir
Head of Product | Greenline Analytics
samir@greenline.ai | +1 (212) 555-3333
